commit.message: fix(mike): classify queue blockers from required CI truth

intent: Make Merge Master Mike's queue classifier derive BLOCKED_CHECKS and WAITING_CHECKS authority only from the required entries in docs/governance/CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json. Preserve observed advisory and uncontracted failures in queue evidence and reasons, while keeping a required-green PR eligible for the existing fanout statuses. This changes queue selection only; the deterministic merge gate continues to consume the full fail-closed CI Truth result.

negative_controls.name: advisory-failure-cannot-hide-required-green-pr

honest_blockers: Open PR #1185 also changes scripts/runtime/pr_merge_control.py with a large stale hardening bundle. This fresh-main packet is deliberately confined to classify_pr plus narrow tests; it supersedes any queue-classifier behavior bundled in #1185, but does not supersede that PR's distinct risk, review-evidence, or fanout-isolation proposals.

AgentOps packet scope is not named in CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json required or advisory entries at this base. The shared CI Truth evaluator reports it as an uncontracted warning; under the repository contract, only required entries carry merge or queue-blocking authority.
The packet changes queue and fanout visibility only. build_gate remains fail-closed on missing, pending, failed, cancelled, timed-out, action-required, or unknown required CI states.
No GitHub state is mutated by this packet; live PR #1290 and #1111 checks are read-only counterexamples used for orientation only.
interface_mismatches: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md has no entry for the pr_merge_control queue-classifier to CI Truth contract boundary; this packet closes the observed authority mismatch without adding a new interface or truth store.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the single local commit for this packet; no state migration, workflow mutation, or external side effect is involved.
